message:
Fix NoMethodError when Active Job's logger is a BroadcastLogger

ActiveSupport::BroadcastLogger#tagged is now always defined (#58429),
so ActiveJob::Logging#tag_logger could no longer rely on
logger.respond_to?(:tagged) to guarantee logger.formatter responds to
ActiveSupport::Logger) raised NoMethodError on
ActiveSupport::Logger::SimpleFormatter#current_tags.

Fixes #58843
